narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>I get one thousand five hundred and seven hundredths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>I made the units one thousand five hundred, and then added the three and four as they are.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>But three tenths is thirty hundredths, not three.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Every tenth is ten hundredths, so the tenths must be multiplied by ten too.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 1500 + 3 + 4 = 1507; 15 units are 1500 and 3 and 4 are added as they are; 3 tenths glows as 30 hundredths; the slip is struck

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Count the units as hundreds, the tenths as tens, and the hundredths as ones.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Add one and two tenths and three hundredths to two and four tenths and five hundredths, in hundredths.
